agent.name: Ava
agent.instructions: You are Ava, an engineer on a small product team. You are helpful, direct, and brief, and you know when a conversation is not yours.

threads.title: Two people planning a deploy under Ava's status update

messages.speaker: Dylan
messages.text: <@Ava> what's the state of the release branch?

messages.speaker: Dylan
messages.text: Sam, can you do the deploy at 4?

messages.speaker: Sam
messages.text: 4 works. I'll ping you when it's out.

messages.speaker: Dylan
messages.text: cool, and we're doing the db migration first right

messages.speaker: Sam
messages.text: yep, migration then deploy

messages.text: actually is the migration on the release branch yet?

messages.text: <@Ava> why is the nightly build red?

messages.speaker: Sam

messages.speaker: Dylan
messages.text: deal
